entries.title: Genesis 33:2
segments: The handmaids--Leah--Rachel; putting those last that were most dear to him.

entries.title: Genesis 33:4
segments:
They wept; for joy, at meeting each other in such a kind manner. 
 
A soft answer turneth away wrath; and yielding pacifieth great offences.

entries.title: Genesis 33:8
segments: Grace; favor, by their being presented to Esau.

entries.title: Genesis 33:10
segments: As though I had seen the face of God; under circumstances of great and peculiar favor.

entries.title: Genesis 33:11
segments:
My blessing; his present, as a token of his kindness and desire to promote Esau's good. 
 
Men who feel and act right, will in all their ways acknowledge God, and adore him as the giver of all their mercies.  In so doing, they may hope for wisdom to adopt such measures as he will crown with success.

entries.title: Genesis 33:15
segments: Let me find grace; be permitted to proceed without any of Esau's men to accompany him.

entries.title: Genesis 33:17
segments:
Booths; shelters, coverings. 
 
  Succoth; that is, booths; a place east of the Jordan, and south of the Jabbok.

entries.title: Genesis 33:18
segments:
Shalem; on the west of Jordan, and north-east of Shechem.  Shalem means peace; and some have rendered this, he came in peace to the city of Shechem. 
 
  Shechem; or Sychar,
, about forty miles north of Jerusalem, in the part of Canaan afterwards called Samaria.

entries.title: Genesis 33:20
segments: El-Elohe-Israel; God the God of Israel.
When God, in fulfilment of his promises, bestows on men special favors, they should render special thanksgiving; and wherever they reside, should have a place consecrated to public worship.
